name: Bell field
brief: Struck bells scattered sparsely over a quiet bed. The tuning is a fixed table of frequencies, not a scale built on a root: many of its pitches stand in whole-number ratios to each other (264, 320, 360, 384 and 528 Hz among them), so notes that sound together ring clean but don't fall into a major or minor key. A few bell notes a minute at most, each left to ring out, with silence between them. A soft pad or a low drone underneath may hold the field together. No beat.
